title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
statement:
A sorted array of N distinct integers has been rotated at some unknown pivot. Given this rotated array and a target T, return the 0-indexed position of T, or -1 if not found.

You must solve this in O(log N) using a modified binary search:
- At each step, determine which half is sorted.
- Check if T falls in the sorted half; if so, narrow there; otherwise search the other half.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and T.
Line 2: N space-separated integers (rotated sorted).
outputFormat: A single integer: the 0-indexed position of T, or -1 if not found.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^6
-10^9 <= A[i] <= 10^9
All elements are distinct.
-10^9 <= T <= 10^9

examples.explanation: 0 is at index 4 in the rotated array.
